name: harness-intake-agent-team
description: Natural-language-first Agent-Team Factory for analyzing external agent harness setups, authorized sessions, skills, commands, and generating quarantined ZOB team/factory proposals.
safeEntrypoints: npm run harness:intake -- "Analyze ../repo-x as a Claude Code setup and propose a ZOB team"
npm run harness:intake:tmux -- start "Analyze ../repo-x with authorized sessions"
noShipBlockers: target path missing or broad root without explicit allow flag
session files read without explicit authorization
secret-like path or credential-like content included in source artifacts
raw session body persisted in reports or generated prompts
team/factory candidate lacks evidence refs for activation claim
tmux launch treated as completion without validation
tmux kickoff-dispatch missing startup_file_delivery=true or raw_prompt_transport_line_by_line=false

stages.name: infer-natural-language-run-spec
stages.expectedOutcome: Compile the natural-language request into inferred-run-spec.v1 without requiring user-authored JSON.

stages.name: source-cartography
stages.expectedOutcome: Source index and risk report for approved harness setup files.

stages.name: harness-and-skill-analysis
stages.expectedOutcome: Harness, skills, commands, prompts, and workflow pattern profiles with evidence.

stages.name: session-mining-if-authorized
stages.expectedOutcome: Behavioral session signals with no raw session body persistence.

stages.name: team-and-factory-proposals
stages.expectedOutcome: Quarantined team and factory candidates under generated-proposals/.

stages.name: oracle-validation
stages.expectedOutcome: validation.json, oracle-review.json, phase sentinel, and DONE only when no no-ship blockers remain.

stages.name: tmux-visible-launch
stages.expectedOutcome: Visible local Pi panes with kickoff files; launch is not completion.
